name: THE TOWN
note: HALF THE TOWN, watching, at the saloon end. Doc 57 F4: 'The first time Thad steps onto the street after T_ASSAY_RUN, Fanshawe is waiting with half the town and the judges' table on the boardwalk, Sowerby holding the pencil.' Cut from room-02 operations 1 and 2 by tools/art/room02-duel-cast.py and laid over Room 2's own street. Present for the visit the duel is called on (T_DUEL_CROWD), and gone the next time.
barksNote: The duel is spoken through the assay (content/assay/assay.json).
